purpose: Canonical refs every Gemini call and every pixel polisher receives. Identity/design lock; the 3D guide (model/, hybrid/guide/) owns camera, pose and timing.

illustration_lock.turnaround_layout: 1024x1024, 4x2 cells of 256x512. Top row S, SE, E, NE; bottom row N, NW, W, SW.

pixel_lock.fit_test: hybrid/lock/pixel/fit_8dir_3x.png (head stamps over an auto-pixelized lock body, 3 terrains; body is NOT lock quality)

gemini_ref_order.rule: First refs weigh most. Always pass the style anchor first, then the lock cell for the direction, then the pose guide, then head sheet / expressions, costume truth last.
gemini_ref_order.handedness_trick: Gemini's prior puts the katana in her RIGHT hand and 'fixes' prompts that ask for the left. Paint in mirror space: mirror the guide (and lock cell), ask for the sword in her RIGHT hand, then mirror the result back. That is how turn8_iso.png was made (wip/turn8_m_pro1 -> _FLIP). Per-cell edit prompts that ask to move the sword failed 8/8.
known_failure_modes: iso_v5 as image 1 with a front-view request returns iso_v5 itself (SE pose): put the guide first or use an edit of a guide-traced sheet
asking for 8 figures can return 12 or 3: say 'exactly 8 figures, same 4x2 grid, do not add or reorder'
adds a sheath / second sword unless told 'NO sheath, nothing on her hip or back, one sword'
katana guard drifts to a giant sickle or trident: pass hybrid/lock/katana.png

decisions.sword_hand: LEFT hand (refs/1 + design_bible 0.5). refs/2 two-handed grip on her left side agrees; refs/3 is ambiguous; iso_v5 and turnaround_v6 are mirrored per the bible. Attacks may be two-handed.
decisions.bow_position: Bow centred on the front base of the bun with both loops rising above it (as the lock sheet draws it in all 8 views). The bible's 'offset to her right side' is dropped so the HEAD reads symmetric; head stamps for W/NW/SW are mirrors of E/NE/SE plus a hand re-light. Bodies stay asymmetric: never mirror a body.
decisions.head_scale: Follow iso_v5, not bible 3: skull H ~22 px and head ~26 px wide on a 60 px sprite (head+bow ~48% of height).
decisions.collar: Prompts always ask for a tall stiff flared collar open at the front. The lock sheet draws it closer to iso_v5's wrapped look; at sprite scale it is a 2-3 px red band round the jaw with a pointed flare tip each side (polisher adds the tips).
decisions.camera: The lock sheet camera is flatter (~15-20 deg) than the 30 deg game camera. Camera/pose come from the 3D guide; the lock is for identity only.
decisions.rim_light: Not baked into stamps; applied on the full silhouette (pink_0, <= 60% of contour, broken).
known_lock_defects: turn8_iso E: far-hand blade painted by hand behind the skirt (only the blade shows)
turn8_iso NE: extra right-hand sword painted out by hand; the remaining left blade shows no hilt
turn8_iso: corset back shows a single buckle; choker, arm ornament and hip pouch are dropped (all DROP/SIMPLIFY at sprite scale anyway)
